context.body: Divine action, human obedience, a personal name, saving mission, and scriptural interpretation converge.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The child is conceived from the Holy Spirit, named Jesus because he will save his people from sins, and identified through Isaiah’s “God with us.”
observations.label: God is named in Jesus’ conception and mission: action

observations.body: Joseph receives the angelic message, obeys, takes Mary, and names the child.
observations.label: God is named in Jesus’ conception and mission: response

observations.body: Holy Spirit · Jesus · save · Immanuel · God with us
observations.label: Words in Matthew 1:18–25

payload.posture: Read Matthew 1:18–25 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene names Jesus and Immanuel but does not explain all later claims about how God is present in him.
payload.title: God is named in Jesus’ conception and mission
